{{Quote|I'm not finished yet, sir. We can do this, General!|Clone Captain Keeli, speaking to Ima-Gun Di during their final stand on Ryloth|<ref name="ARC" />}}
'''Keeli''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]], but [[Death/Legends|died]] in service while on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

==Biography==
[[File:CaptainKeeli-TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|Captain Keeli in full battle armor]]
[[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] on the water world of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Keeli was dispatched at some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] to serve under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]], and help [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Di's troops began to run perilously low on men, [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and medical aid. Seeing their dangerous situation, the [[General/Legends|general]] devised a plan to cut off all alleys of attack except for one, and to summarily channel the battle droids through it in a desperate attempt to buy the Twi'leks time to escape over the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]].<ref name="ARC" />

This plan worked, and the droids began to stream into the pass. Keeli's forces were decimated to the last man, including Keeli and Di. Keeli had been knocked unconscious by a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] in the course of the fighting, but as Di was being overrun by the droids, he regained his footing and kept fighting. He helped fend off the surrounding droids with Master Ima-Gun Di. While back-to-back with his Jedi general, Keeli was shot once in the shoulder and then in the chest. Soon after, Di was overrun and killed, but their efforts were not to be in vain for the Twi'leks escaped and got their food and medical supplies.<ref name="ARC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Like all clones in the series, Keeli was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="ARC" />
